title: Dyonic hairy black holes in $U(1)$ gauge-invariant scalar-vector-tensor theories: Cubic and quartic SVT sectors
summary: We construct and classify asymptotically flat, static, and spherically symmetric hairy black hole solutions in $U(1)$ gauge-invariant scalar-vector-tensor (SVT) theories carrying both electric and magnetic charges. Extending previous analyses restricted to ${\cal L}_{\rm SVT}^{2}$, we incorporate the cubic and quartic SVT sectors, ${\cal L}_{\rm SVT}^{3}$ and ${\cal L}_{\rm SVT}^{4}$, respectively.
